normalization: 32x32 nearest cell, font baseline + glyph bearings; output resampled at native pixel centers
testPolicy: Cozette/Spleen families + exact normalized Latin duplicates held out; no test-based checkpoint selection
humanAcceptability: Not yet rated; pixel distance is not a legibility/style score
topK: Best-of-returned, up to 8 total interleaved CNN/retrieval candidates; deduplication may reduce counts. No test-based model/threshold tuning.

training.donorPolicy: Different font, same character, training split only; same-family training pairs allowed; test families never used
